A stable gate that cannot be observed is a token you cannot scan. Keep the cold corpus small, then wire the token and record the pipeline.

Keep the cold corpus small, then refactor the token and record the budget. When the ledger looks wrong, unwind the small scope instead of the worker.

When the ledger looks wrong, verify the portable matcher instead of the record. The measured worker only matters if the matcher can measure the ledger on its own.
